en.html:
After sunset, Chachamaru took me out of the castle. She drove herself, through the city and toward the bay.

We eventually stopped in the parking lot of an expensive hotel, fairly well known around Kamakura. Both of us wore civilian clothes. In this establishment, military uniforms might actually have looked more at home.

Of course there must have been a reason to avoid announcing rank and name at one glance. Especially hers. A uniform is a very talkative garment.

We went in through a deserted rear entrance and entered the elevator.

Up it went—to the top floor.

　自ら車を運転して、市中を抜け、湾岸方面へ向かう。

　やがて停車した場所は、鎌倉近郊でそれなりに名を
知られている高級ホテルの駐車場だった。
　今は俺も茶々丸も私服だが、場所柄、かえって軍服

特に茶々丸――を避けたのには理由があるのだろうが。

　昇降機は――最上階へ。

Chachamaru"AAAA! Answer became too direct!"
Wolf"What are you doing, my dear? Arrive, and straightaway a sentence is hanging over you."
Chachamaru"YOU opened with SHOELACES, you lace-brained langoor! Whose fault is this!?"
Wolf"Yours, presumably. A foolish person has done something foolish. Very ordinary explanation."
Kageaki"Correct."
Wolf"Hoo, as expected. A good friend of mine, but this habit of blaming others without proper reason—quite a defect."
Wolf"My perfectly reasonable campaign for double knots, even that she opposes."
Kageaki"The blaming should be corrected. Shoelaces can wait."
Wolf"A friend's duty, I consider it. Watch over her warmly, keep giving advice. This is my intention."
Kageaki"A sound approach."
Kageaki"How fortunate in your friends, Chachamaru."
Wolf"Indeed! Fortunate girl!"
Chachamaru"...Uff... uff... sniff..."
Wolf"Arre, why are you genuinely crying?"
Chachamaru"Because from the bottom of my heart apun wanted to CRY! Saala, lately the whole world has forgotten how to be nice!"
Wolf"Hai, so much trouble. And still no respect for a properly tied shoe."
Kageaki"Agreed. Now, shoelace lunatic."
Wolf"Yes?"
Kageaki"What sort of gathering is being held here?"

Kageaki"I trust this is not a conference on shoelace knots and public health."
Wolf"Hmmm. Not the target exactly, but not so very far from it..."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"LIE! Not on target, not nearby, different bloody district! Please stop looking at apun as though the punishment has already been selected!"
Wolf"Suppose people argued about which shoe must be tied first, right or left. Would you call them ridiculous?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Wolf"And Christians fiercely arguing over the correct order for making the sign of the cross? Ridiculous also?"
Kageaki"..."
Wolf"Ridiculous, my friend."
Wolf"A value that does not exist... they treat it as existing, revere it, even fight other people over its validity."
Wolf"Ridiculous."
Wolf"...Lekin this, precisely this—is it not intellectual activity?"
Wolf"Without intelligence, how will you manage such elaborate nonsense?"
Wolf"Obeying reality, anybody can do. A beast without intelligence also manages. But give fiction the same value as truth, then fall down before it—can a beast do that? Such advanced complication requires a human brain."

en.html:
Kageaki"You are speaking of religion?"
Wolf"Exactly."
Wolf"Some have said religion makes fools of mankind. Complete misunderstanding. Religion is the product of intellectual activity of an extremely high order. To be foolish like this, first the brain must do tremendous work."
Wolf"The most human invention in human history, one might call it."
Kageaki"I see. Religion as an intellectual game..."
Kageaki"Ridiculous."
Wolf"Thoroughly."
Kageaki"But considered that way, not bad."
Wolf"Hai na?"
Kageaki"Hmph..."
Wolf"Ha-ha-ha!"
Chachamaru"...How is conversation actually happening between you two?"
Kageaki"Then this gathering is a religious debate, or something of that kind?"
Wolf"Not a debate, no. The conclusion has already arrived."
Wolf"We are discussing what action to take on that conclusion."
Kageaki"Which conclusion?"
Wolf"We shall commit blasphemy against God."
Wolf"God, existing as a sacred fiction, a hope no hand could touch—we shall drag that God down onto this earth. Make it real, like a monster."
Wolf"Comrade Kageaki Minato. Late I am with the greeting, but meeting you today will remain a joy for my whole life."
Kageaki"...Your name. I have not heard it yet."
Wolf"Wolf."
Kageaki"Wolf...?"

Twenty or thereabouts, she looked. Fine features... but the impression was gloomy.

Her eyes were dark. No welcome waiting there.

ウォルフ「ほォ。 　では今日は二名もの新たな仲間を迎え入れ られるわけか」
ウォルフ「輝かしい日だな！」

en.html:
Chachamaru went up to Jouansai and whispered a few words.

He heard her out in silence. After a short pause, the Yagyuu man nodded. Not an extra movement offered.

ja.html:
常闇斎に近寄り、茶々丸が二言三言囁く。

　それを黙って聞き終え。
　やや間を置いて、柳生の男は頷いた。

en.html:
Jouansai"...I see. Certainly, leaving this alone might be dangerous."
Chachamaru"Apun has to leave for Sasagawa tomorrow. So, a favor..."
Jouansai"Leave it to me. I shall choose someone reliable and send them to investigate."
Chachamaru"That helps, yaar."
Jouansai"No great trouble."

常闇斎「……左様でございますか。 　確かに、放置するのは危険かもしれません」
茶々丸「あては明日から篠川へ行かなきゃなんねえ。 　それで、頼みたいんだが……」
常闇斎「お任せ下さいませ。 　信頼の置ける者を選び、調査に向かわせま しょう」
茶々丸「助かるわ」
常闇斎「何程のことでもありません」
